messages:
maya: Quick sync — now that v1.2 is live, we need to lock iteration priorities for the next 2 weeks (bugs vs enhancements). TL;DR: customer signal + crash heat = decisions.
ajay: Can we get a surface-level count? how many P0/P1 bugs vs enhancement requests in the backlog?
lin: P0: 1 crash affecting ~3% of sessions. P1: 6 issues (timeout, kb cache miss, minor rendering). Enh requests: ~14 items; 5 are small UX polish, rest are new flows.
ben: Re: cost of switching dev focus — suggested split: 40% bug fixes (including the P0), 35% stability/infra (timeouts, caching), 25% enhancements. That keeps a runway for follow-ons.
aria: Customer asks: large customer A wants conversation export CSV and a small tweak to role-based filtering. Export is an enhancement but high ACV. Thoughts on fast-tracking?
maya: Proposal: treat customer A export as conditional enhancement -> if we can deliver as a 2-day spike + feature flag, prioritise. Otherwise, put on M2.
ajay: For clarity — define M1 = fixes + hotpatches (2-week window), M2 = higher-impact enhancements and customer commits (next 4–6 weeks).
lin: I can take the P0 crash today; will target a patch and smoke tests. Deploy window then. Also adding a quick regression test to the CI.
ben: Can ops help with an emergency canary and rollback playbook? deploy-bot: deploy started by lin on canary slot: api-v1.2.1-canary @1715234572
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded on canary @1715234578
aria: If canary looks good, customer A wants a beta flag next week for export. We should confirm data policy/PII implications before enabling.
maya: Decision checklist (agree?): 1) P0 fix = immediate (owner: lin). 2) Reserve 40% engineering capacity for bug+infra in M1. 3) Small UX polishes deprioritised unless quick (<1 dev-day). 4) Customer A export = spike now; gated by privacy review. Reply with :thumbsup: if you agree.
ben: :thumbsup:
ajay: :thumbsup:
lin: will start work and post status in #eng-runtime.
aria: adding privacy reviewer (sam) to thread — please review export data model by EOD tomorrow.
maya: Follow-ups: set two tickets in the sprint board: BUG-P0-1715 (lin), M1-capacity-plan-1716 (maya), EXPORT-spike-1717 (aria). I'll update roadmap milestones: M1 (stability window) due +14 days, M2 (customer/enhancements) scope freeze in 4 weeks.
ajay: Quick ask — can we quantify customer-facing risk if we postpone the 5 small UX items? maybe a chart of session drop vs bug severity? if not, assume low.
lin: quick note: P0 stacktrace points to kv-cache eviction under load. Patch will change eviction threshold and improve logging. I'll paste the test snippet here:
```
// repro script
ab -n 1000 -c 20 http://internal/api/v1/stream
# watch logs for cache.eviction.warn
```
maya: Thanks. I'll draft a short external comms note for customers: "We identified an intermittent crash, rolling out a targeted fix; feature requests will follow in cycle 2." Share for review before sending.
aria: I'll coordinate with AE for customer A beta. Marking export spike as blocked until privacy signoff.
ben: Ops note: please add a temporary alert for increased cache.eviction.warn and elevated 5xx rate so SRE can act quickly.
maya: All good — if no objections by EOD, we'll lock the plan and groom the sprint. Action owners: lin (P0), maya (capacity plan & comms), aria (export spike + AE), ben (alerts). Closing thread when tickets created.
ajay: ack. keeping an eye.
deploy-bot: canary promoted to prod at 1715234595 (api-v1.2.1) — monitor for any regressions.
lin: prod looks clean so far. will post final PR and link to patch in the ticket.
maya: closing loop: plan locked, sprint updated. Thank you everyone."
